intro: Coldridge Valley Mail Delivery is a simple courier task entrusted to recruits by Sten Stoutarm at Anvilmar. With mountain passes often choked with snow and troggs pressing nearby, carrying fresh correspondence out to the camps along the frozen lake keeps the valley's isolated defenders connected.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Hm, I don't suppose you'd be willing to do a favor for me, friend? A stack of letters came through the pass today, but I don't have the time to send them along.
They're all addressed to Talin Keeneye. You can find him to the west down the road. He's set up camp next to the frozen lake.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Yes? Do you have something for me?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Thank you, I've been waiting for these letters for quite some time...
Unfortunately, these letters aren't all for me. This one is addressed to Grelin Whitebeard. He's not too far away if you'd like to deliver it to him.
